description: Objects and the assets they use, pasted or opened into a figure. Units are points (1/72 in).
title: Figure fragment

Id.description:
Stable ids for everything a project holds (note 02). An id never changes once made, so renaming or reordering never breaks a reference.

The prefix says what the id names, which keeps saved files and bug reports readable: `d_` document, `pg_` page, `ly_` layer, `o_` object, `ts_` text style, `sw_` swatch.

rotation.description: Degrees, clockwise on screen, about the frame centre.

Frame.description: Top-left of the unrotated box; flipped about, then rotated about, its centre.

PathNode.description: A path vertex with optional cubic handles, frame-local; no handle = corner.

bind.description: Binding to objects: Phase 4; kept losslessly now.

size.description: Head length as a multiple of the stroke width.

lineHeight.description: Line height as a multiple of the largest run size on the line.

step.description: This text is a numbered step badge on another object (note 48).

target.description: The object the badge is attached to; deleting it deletes the badge.

offset.description: From the anchor corner to the badge's centre, points.

variant.description: A filled circle with a white number, or the number alone.

paint.description: The circle's fill, or the plain number's colour.

StepLink.description: What makes a text a step badge (note 48). The number is derived (reading order of the targets in the badge's group or page) and, with the badge's position and size, written into the text only by `reconcileBindings`.

StepAnchor.description: The corner of the target's bounds a step badge's centre sits at (plus its offset).

slots.description: Overrides only; defaults come from the asset's SlotDefs.

asset.description: The whole picture, kept so a crop can be changed or undone (note 20). With `channels`, the merge of them, baked (note 21).

crop.description: What is shown, in pixels of `asset` (its `meta` size), or of `asset` turned by `turn`; none = all of it. A see-through picture's backdrop (an `svgImport`) is cropped with its picture, in its `meta` units (note 20).

turn.description: Degrees (clockwise) the pixels of `asset` are turned, resampled, before `crop` is taken (issue 48, note 20): a crop level on the page of a turned picture. `crop` is then in pixels of the turned picture (its bounding box, same pixel size). Only with `crop`; none = not turned.

cropped.description: The pixels of `crop`, re-encoded as their own image asset (note 20): the export subset has no clipping, so this is what is drawn when `crop` is set.

channels.description: A pseudocoloured merge (note 21): the channels `asset` is baked from, kept so a channel can be recoloured, re-ranged or turned off later.

levels.description: Levels and invert over the whole picture (note 27): `asset` is `levels.base` adjusted, baked. Applied after a merge and before a crop.

splitSet.description: The pictures of one "Split channels" row (note 45), this one included: a crop or levels change on one is offered to the rest. Ids that no longer exist are ignored.

inset.description: A magnified inset of a region of another picture (note 44).

asset.description: The channel's own picture, as imported; its brightest of R, G, B is the intensity.

on.description: Off: left out of the merge, kept for later.

Channel.description: One channel of a merged picture (note 21): a single-channel picture shown in `color`, its display range `min`..`max` (0–255) stretched to full brightness.

base.description: The picture the levels were applied to, unadjusted.

Levels.description: Levels and invert for one picture (note 27): `min`..`max` (0–255) stretched to the full range on every colour component, then optionally inverted. `base` is the picture before this (the plain picture or the channel merge), kept so levels can be changed or removed without compounding; `Image.asset` is then the baked result.

source.description: The picture the region is of.

box.description: The outline rectangle on the source; dragging it re-crops the inset.

lines.description: The connector lines (open two-node paths), box corners to inset corners.

stale.description: `crop` changed since `cropped` was baked: the app re-bakes the pixels.

InsetLink.description: What makes a picture a magnified inset of a region of another (note 44): the region is its own `crop` (with `turn`) in pixels of the source's `asset`; the outline box on the source and the connector lines are plain objects named here, laid out only by `reconcileBindings` (note 06).

snapshot.description: An `svgImport` asset drawn when the kind is unknown to this version.

children.description: In page coordinates; the group's frame is their bounds, rotation 0.

name.description: The file name it was imported from.

credit.description: Credit the user wants shown in the attribution line, if any.

width.description: Intrinsic size in pixels (images) or points (SVG).

pixelSize.description: µm per pixel, when the file stated it (TIFF import, note 43): a scale bar placed on the picture takes it. Baked pictures (levels, merge) carry it on.

peak.description: Marks a 16-bit greyscale PNG kept as the unadjusted source of a picture (note 43): the brightest sample in it (1-65535), which the Levels sliders span. The browser shows such a PNG as 8-bit, so it is never drawn; the baked 8-bit picture is.

Params_cell.title: cell params
Params_cell.description: A eukaryotic cell (animal, plant, yeast, neuron, epithelial); switch organelles on and off and colour each one.

style.description: Style. How it is drawn; what it shows stays the same.

wall.description: Cell wall. Plants and fungi; 0 for none.

vacuole.description: Vacuole size. Share of the cell; a large one presses the nucleus to the side. 0 for none.

bud.description: Bud size. A daughter bud on the right, as a share of the mother; 0 for none.

microvilli.description: Microvilli. Along the top (apical) edge; the nucleus moves to the base.

Params_bacterium.title: bacterium params
Params_bacterium.description: A bacterium: rod, coccus or curved rod, Gram-negative or Gram-positive, with nucleoid, plasmids, flagella and pili.

style.description: Style. How it is drawn; what it shows stays the same.

Params_bilayer.title: bilayer params
Params_bilayer.description: A phospholipid bilayer along a path; draw a path with the pen and turn it into one.

Params_receptors.title: receptors params
Params_receptors.description: Receptors, channels or transporters spaced along a membrane path.

Params_helix.title: helix params
Params_helix.description: A double helix (or an RNA strand) along a path, with base-pair ticks.

Params_plasmidMap.title: plasmidMap params
Params_plasmidMap.description: A circular or linear map with features; PlasmidPop maps paste in as these.

Params_proteinDomains.title: proteinDomains params
Params_proteinDomains.description: A protein as a bar with its domains to scale, a residue ruler and N/C termini.

Params_wellPlate.title: wellPlate params
Params_wellPlate.description: A 6- to 1536-well plate; paint wells or paste a layout from a spreadsheet.

style.description: Style. How it is drawn; what it shows stays the same.

Params_petriDish.title: petriDish params
Params_petriDish.description: An agar plate with colonies: random, streaked, spotted dilutions, a pinned grid, a lawn or a tetrad dissection.

style.description: Style. How it is drawn; what it shows stays the same.

plate.description: Plate. A rectangular single-well plate (PlusPlate, OmniTray) fills the frame: resize it to 127.8 x 85.5 mm for the SBS footprint that 384 and 1536 pinned grids sit on.

tetrads.description: Tetrads. One column of four spores (a to d) per tetrad.

segregation.description: Segregation. Spores of the usual colour : spores of the marker colour in each tetrad.

dead.description: Dead spores. Spores that germinated but stopped as a tiny microcolony.

missing.description: Missing spores. Spores that did not grow at all: an empty spot.

spotCols.description: Dilutions (columns). The first spot is confluent, each next one a 10-fold dilution of it.

rowLabels.description: Row labels. A, B, C... beside each strain row.

discs.description: Antibiotic discs. Paper discs on the lawn, each with a clear inhibition halo.

haloSize.description: Halo width. Clear zone beyond the disc edge; it varies a little between discs.

plaques.description: Plaques. Clear spots where phage lysed the lawn.

markerShare.description: Marker colour share. Share of colonies drawn in the marker colour, for blue/white or red/white screens.

seed.description: Arrangement. Another number gives another arrangement.

Params_gel.title: gel params
Params_gel.description: A gel with a ladder and lanes of bands; type band sizes in bp.

style.description: Style. How it is drawn; what it shows stays the same.

Params_gelLabels.title: gelLabels params
Params_gelLabels.description: Lane labels and ladder sizes for a gel photo, laid over the picture.

shift.description: Shift. Moves this lane off its even place, for a gap in the comb (percent of the width).

first.description: First lane at. Centre of the first lane, from the left edge of the picture.

last.description: Last lane at. Centre of the last lane; the lanes in between are evenly spaced (unless shifted).

at.description: Height. Down from the top of the picture.

Params_scaleBar.title: scaleBar params
Params_scaleBar.description: A scale bar for a micrograph, calibrated from its pixel size.

pixelSize.description: Pixel size. From the microscope or image metadata, e.g. 0.065 µm for a 100× objective.

imageWidth.description: Image width. The picture’s width in pixels; set for you by Add scale bar.

label.description: Label text. Leave empty to write the length.

margin.description: Margin. From the edges of the picture.

Params_timeline.title: timeline params
Params_timeline.description: A time axis with events (injection, boost, harvest) and treatment periods as bars.

step.description: Tick step. 0 picks a step that leaves the labels room.

end.description: Bracket end. Brackets only: the time the bracket reaches.

Params_sequence.title: sequence params
Params_sequence.description: A short DNA, RNA or protein sequence with a numbering ruler, highlighted residues and labelled bars.

sequence.description: Sequence. DNA, RNA or protein; letters, - and * are kept, upper-cased, up to 200 residues.

start.description: From. Residue numbers, counted from the first residue number.
From. For one residue, give the same number twice.

Params_studyDesign.title: studyDesign params
Params_studyDesign.description: Study arms stacked on one time axis, with injection, dosing, sampling and endpoint markers and treatment bars.

step.description: Tick step. 0 picks a step that leaves the labels room.

n.description: n. 0 leaves n out of the label.

arm.description: Arm. The arm’s number in the list above.
Arm. 0 draws the bar on every arm.

Params_tree.title: tree params
Params_tree.description: A phylogenetic or clustering tree drawn from a pasted Newick string, rectangular or circular, with optional collapsed clades.

newick.description: Newick. A tree such as ((A:1,B:1)90:1,C:2); up to 4000 characters. Quoted labels, :lengths and [comments] work.

branchLengths.description: Use branch lengths. Off (or no lengths in the string): a cladogram, tips aligned.

support.description: Show node labels. Support values or clade names on the internal nodes.

collapse.description: Collapsed clades. A clade’s label, or a leaf in it (its parent clade), or two leaves a,b (the smallest clade holding both). Drawn as a triangle.

scaleBar.description: Scale bar. A branch-length bar under a rectangular tree drawn with lengths.

Params_placeholderPlot.title: placeholderPlot params
Params_placeholderPlot.description: A plot-shaped placeholder (PCA, UMAP, scatter, bar or flow cytometry) drawn from a seed.

groups.description: Groups. Clusters, or bars of a bar chart. Flow cytometry uses the first colour for events and the second for events inside the polygon gate.

events.description: Events. How many cells the flow plot draws.

gate.description: Gate. The percentages are the share of the drawn events in each region.

spread.description: Spread. How loose the clusters, or how long the error bars, are.

xLabel.description: x-axis label. Empty uses the usual label for the plot type.

legend.description: Group names. A legend beside the plot; under the bars of a bar chart.

seed.description: Arrangement. Another number gives another set of points.
